original_requirements.quote:
• Calculate the cooling load of the open plan office using rule of thumb. 
• Determine the total supply air flow rate of the office. 
• Distribute supply air diffusers on the layout plan. 
• Calculate the supply air flow rate of each diffuser. 
• Find out the characteristic room length, L. 
• Refer to the performance data of KRUEGER “Louvered Face Diffusers 1400, 51400 
Series 4-cone”, and select a suitable type of diffuser. 
• From the diffuser performance data, find the corresponding T0.25. 
• Calculate T0.25 / L. 
• Check if it meets the ASHRAE ADPI requirement.
